_doc: Verdicts beside the Jev harvest sitting over San Joaquin Delta College (typesafe-smoke.yml run 39206690775, 2026-10-19; artifact jev-harvest, harvest_san_joaquin_delta.json; 49 records failing a machine check, 49 asked). Each verdict is a SESSION's reading (S421 SkyTupelo) of the committed record's own score, figures, blocks and the first reader's notes, which quote the page; the session did not read the catalog page itself, and Sam has not read these. 'agree': the record's evidence supports Jev's cause and owner; 'owner_differs': the cause holds, the fix belongs elsewhere; 'cause_differs': the evidence names another cause; 'unverified': the record alone cannot settle it. No gate is set: kb/_jev_adjudicate.py GATES takes a measured precision on a person's verdicts, and these are a session's.
verdicts_by: session S421 (SkyTupelo), from the records' scores and notes; not Sam

rows.title: Agriculture Business

reading: Jev's cause held on 17 rows (12 agree, 5 owner_differs) and leaned wrong on 32, almost all one way: it read a sum that runs past the printed total as a misread block, when the records show the blocks read as printed and the check comparing both ends of a range against a single figure. Delta prints every total as a floor ('Minimum Units Required: N', 'Minimum Major Units Required: N') and the sum's low end equals it on 29 of the 35 unequal rows; the range comes from three page shapes the record carries faithfully: a one-unit alternative in an all-required block (ENGL C1000E 4 beside ENGL C1000 3, STAT C1000E 4.5 beside STAT C1000 4, on 18 rows), a block printed as a range ('Complete 4 - 6 units', '1 - 3 units', 'INDUS 94 or Associate Degree Math Requirement 4', on 5), and a variable-unit course printed 1-4 inside a required block (CUL ART 93V, PETHEORY 69V, ATH 1, on 5, plus 37638's choose_courses over 3- and 4-unit courses). One scorer rule clears them: read the program total as a floor the way degree_total_minimum already reads the degree total, passing when the sum's low end meets it (or, equivalently, prefer an all-required block's printed stated figure when the sum's low end equals it). Where Jev named the scorer it was right; where it named the extraction for these rows the record had nothing to change. The second fix is a subject-prefix alias in the scorer (same number and title, different prefix: ANTH/ANTHR, ENGL/ENG, ARTH/ART, COMM/COM ST), which clears the five arithmetic-equal rows failing coverage and invented (18815, 31692, 32341, 32913, 40824) and 37638's coverage. The seven noncredit hours rows are one more scorer rule (a page printing only 'Total Contact Hours' and 'Units: 0' per course is unaddable, pass it as 'unstated' passes a page with no figure). What remains for the extraction is small and real: 07304's double-counted elective block, 16764's waivable piano block recorded as required units, 22244's unrecorded 4-unit math requirement, 45621's area minimums, and 11970's three course-less GE areas; 19752 is the reader's (the GE page, not the Spanish major); 05630 and 44197 want a scorer field (a certificate total that includes its GE units; a course taken four times). S422 (#2250): the three scorer readings built from this reading (the program total as a floor, the prefix aliases, the noncredit total-only page) took Delta's live rows from 154 to 195 of 202 passing (reconciles 39217405432 and 39220195737, rereads 39223153428 and 39223682919); the eight left are the extraction rows this reading names. S424 SkyBuckthorn, 2026-10-19: two scorer rules from the owner_differs rows, each a certificate with no degree total: 05630 passes when the record's ge_units make the printed total exact (ge_included), and 11970 passes when electives_fill_degree is set and the sum is short of the total (fill), with the degree check's guard that a text naming no electives keeps it failing. 22244 (a non-course requirement line), 07304, 16764 and 45621 (the model's reading of a choice, a waivable block, an area minimum) and 44197 (a repeat count the record shape has no field for) stay as read; the second reader is the next read of those four, and 19752 (the GE page handed the model) is Delta's page assignment.
